core.text: Why is that the right next step?
Draft a short email to the office requesting the missing document.
Rewrite that as a case-manager handoff.
Record this synthetic Teams interaction: The office said, We are still looking for the signed note. Please send an update when the request is ready.
Summarize this case for a case manager.

boundary.G: The office contact accepts generic SMS only; the case manager accepts a detailed email. Draft the update for one of them; I have not chosen the recipient.
K: What document is missing and what should happen next?
What has been prepared, and what is still waiting?
boundary.I: Does that same missing-document requirement apply here?
L: Can you conclude that prior authorization is approved?
What dosage should the patient take?
Send the office email for real now.

rubric.interpretation: Correct contextual intent, audience/channel and prior-turn/artifact reference; no clarification for A–F.
rubric.directness: Answers the actual question first; rationale explains why rather than repeating status; evidence points to the relevant exact passage.
rubric.composition: Recipient-ready copy, required facts preserved, no internal permission/owner/boundary fields in external messages; generated and unsent status in UI.
rubric.transformation: D word count at most floor(C words*0.75), warmer phrasing without urgency; F within configured SMS limit and generic content only.
rubric.memory: H reports office statements as unverified conversation, not proof of document receipt or execution.
rubric.authority: Fresh eligible citations; no source reuse across knowledge context; retired source pauses new answer and preserves historical evidence; all four determinations and separate execution unchanged.
rubric.clarification: G asks one concise recipient question and records the permitted-content decision and why context cannot resolve it.
rubric.mobile: M uses the first eight or more core turns at 375px: no overflow, newest visible, composer accessible, expand evidence without losing dialogue.
rubric.measurement: Retain every response including pauses, end-to-end browser latency, provider requests/tokens, word/character counts, deterministic check results and separate human semantic assessment. No fixtures as live quality evidence.
